card.name: Words linking to organizations or programs
card.fires_on: Words that sit right before or inside an organization, program or account name, such as 'with' after a physician, or 'program' after a program type. Seen in general web text about clinics, nonprofits and schools.

modes.label: Link to an organization
modes.description: A small linking word after a job title that leads into the employer's name.
modes.example: a physician<< with>> Mercy Clinic Internal Medicine

modes.label: Program or account noun
modes.description: The noun 'program', 'programme' or 'account' right after a descriptive phrase about an initiative or service.
modes.example: Head Start is a preschool<< program>> for children whose families fall under the poverty

modes.label: Stray punctuation or spacing
modes.description: A period in a version number or a space inside a phone number.

card.plain: It marks spots in web text where an organization, program or its name is about to be described.
